title: SkillTriggerPromptSet
description: Indexed prompt set for skill trigger evaluation (typically 20 items: 10 positive, 10 negative).

id.description: Stable unique index for the prompt/query.

query.description: Prompt text sent to the LLM CLI.

should_trigger.description: Whether the skill under test should be invoked for this query.

runs.description: Optional per-prompt override for number of evaluation runs.
